claims.claim: The title explains the expanded authored-to-endless route before play.
claims.action: Observe the title and select One Warden.
claims.observedSequence: The title visibly named five Oaths, six minutes, Endless Vigil, Hexer wards, and Warlord commands; One Warden opened the eight-second setup without blocking controls.

claims.claim: The active battlefield is genuinely hybrid low-poly 3D with an honest fallback seam.
claims.baselineEvidence: Opening setup frame and live renderer diagnostics.
claims.action: Observe the active stage and read exposed canvas datasets.
claims.observedSequence: Raised approach planes, divergent inner paths, gate towers, hearth, plot pads, and an oblique camera were visibly dimensional. Diagnostics reported renderer=webgl-low-poly, status=active, paletteSteps=16, authority=hybrid-webgl-canvas, with both canvases occupying the same 1244x700 stage.

claims.claim: Hexer and Warlord tactics have distinct visible silhouettes and aura language.
claims.baselineEvidence: Bounded localhost QA state with four enemies.
claims.action: Stage a Hexer/raider pair on north and Warlord/brute pair on south, then capture the settled frame.
claims.observedSequence: The tall purple Hexer carried a bright teal bell/staff and teal ring; the broad red Warlord carried horn-like shoulders and a red command ring. They remained distinguishable against the 3D approach and Canvas markers.

claims.claim: Five bounded Oaths visibly hand the same run into endless play.
claims.action: Use the bounded QA boundary route backed by the same Core.step transitions.
claims.observedSequence: At 6:00 the HUD changed to ENDLESS VIGIL, game datasets reported oathReceipts=5 and oathComplete=true, and the renderer chapter also changed to endless-vigil while the timer continued to 6:04 and beyond.

claims.claim: Outcome and replay expose the new progression and recover cleanly.
claims.action: Trigger the bounded result state, then choose Defend again.
claims.observedSequence: The centered result card showed Warlords, 5/5 Oaths, score, Defend again, and Change mode without clipping. Defend again closed the result, reset the Oath label to EMBER MUSTER, reset receipts to zero, and restored setup.

claims.claim: Pause freezes the expanded run and resume restores it.
claims.action: Pause, observe for 800 ms, resume, and observe for 1100 ms.
claims.observedSequence: The pause overlay was visible and the timer remained 7:03; after resume it advanced to 7:04.

claims.claim: Reload recovery remains honest rather than implying persistence.
claims.observedSequence: The title returned with 0:00, EMBER MUSTER, active WebGL status, and hybrid authority. The in-progress run did not pretend to persist.

claims.claim: The smallest co-op setup still exposes both owned economies.

claims.observedSequence: Both north and south wallets were visible at 105 gold, two warden chips rendered, and the setup banner still explained four plots per side while the Oath label remained EMBER MUSTER.
